newBook.createFirstPrompt: Help me create my first chapter. Ask me about my book's genre, main characters, and the opening scene before writing.
newBook.outlineBookPrompt: Help me create a detailed outline for my book. Ask me about the genre, themes, main characters, and the general story arc I have in mind.
newBook.developCharactersPrompt: Help me develop the main characters for my book. Ask me about the genre and any initial character ideas I have.

noChapter.reviewFullPrompt: Review my book so far — check for pacing issues, plot holes, and consistency across all chapters.
noChapter.planNextPrompt: Based on what's been written so far, help me plan the next chapter. Consider the story arc, unresolved plot threads, and character development.
noChapter.generateSummariesPrompt: Generate a brief summary for each chapter in the book so far.

chapter.summarizePrompt: Please summarize this chapter, highlighting key events and character development.
chapter.checkInconsistenciesPrompt: Check this chapter for any inconsistencies with the rest of the book — timeline issues, character behavior, factual contradictions.
chapter.expandPrompt: Expand the current chapter with more descriptive detail, deeper character introspection, and sensory details. Maintain the existing voice and style.
chapter.makeConcisePrompt: Edit this chapter to be more concise. Remove redundant phrases, tighten dialogue, and cut any passages that don't advance the plot or character development.
chapter.improveDialoguePrompt: Review and improve the dialogue in this chapter. Make each character's voice more distinct and ensure conversations feel natural and purposeful.
chapter.addForeshadowingPrompt: Add subtle foreshadowing elements to this chapter that hint at events in later chapters. The hints should be natural and not heavy-handed.

aiStartPrompt: Help me start writing my book. Ask me about the genre, setting, main characters, and the opening scene before creating the first chapter.
